topic: E-signature for employment contracts — three signatures across two countries, end-to-end in one platform
format: Lead with a quote or question from a customer, then explain the feature built in response
post:
"We had three people who needed to sign one contract — in two different countries. It took us eleven days."

That was the feedback from an HR manager at a mid-size company expanding across the GCC.

Eleven days. For signatures.

We built e-signature directly into SmartPRO Hub's HR and contracts module because that story wasn't unusual. It was routine.

Here's what the workflow looks like now:

An employment contract is generated inside the platform. All three signatories — regardless of whether they're in Muscat, Dubai, or Riyadh — receive a secure signing link. Each signs on their device. The completed contract is timestamped, stored, and linked to the employee record.

No printing. No scanning. No "did you get my email?" No eleven days.

For HR managers and ops directors running cross-border teams, this matters. Hiring delays are rarely about decisions — they're about paperwork that moves slowly between people in different time zones.

SmartPRO Hub connects e-signature with payroll, WPS, and HR records so a completed contract isn't just a document. It's the first step in a connected onboarding process.

One platform. Both countries. Done.

What's the longest your team has waited on a single signature?
